name: schedule_follow_up
description: Schedule a single follow-up message to be sent to this customer after a delay (e.g. to re-engage if they go quiet after you asked a question), or cancel a pending one. The exact text you supply is sen

action.description: What to do: "schedule" (default) to set a follow-up, or "cancel" to remove the currently pending follow-up for this customer. For "schedule" you must also provide message and delay.

message.description: Required for action "schedule". The exact follow-up text to send after the delay. Written in the customer's language and your persona — it is delivered verbatim with no further processing.

delay.description: Required for action "schedule". How long to wait before sending the follow-up (e.g. 5m, 1h, 18h). Must be one of the allowed duration labels.

cancel_on_reply.description: When true (default), the follow-up is automatically cancelled if the customer replies before the timer fires. Set false to send it regardless of whether they reply.

name: send_media
description: Send one or more media files (images, videos, documents) to this customer NOW, before your text reply. Use it to show a subscription/package tile image FIRST, then describe it. Reference each file by

items.description: The media files to send, in order. 1 to 5 items.

asset.description: The registered media asset KEY to send (available: membership_light_intro, membership_light_details, membership_light_price, membership_pro_intro, membership_pro_details, membership_pro_price, membership_ultra_intro, membership_ultra_details, membership_ultra_price, membership_max_intro, membership_max_details, membership_max_price, membership_cover, mens_summer_cover, mens_summer_contouring, mens_summer_beard_neck, mens_summer_underarms, mens_summer_requested, mens_summer_full_body). Provide EITHER asset OR url, not both.

caption.description: Optional caption/description sent WITH the media. On channels without caption support it is delivered as a separate text message right after the media.

filename.description: Optional filename shown for document-type media.

name: verify_bank_transfer
description: Verify a bank transfer (CliQ) a customer says they sent, and record it against their account. Call action:"claim" with the amount, the sender name on the transfer, and roughly when they sent it — a se

action.description: "claim" to submit the customer's claim for verification. "settle" to record an approved payment. "flag_for_review" AFTER claims have failed and you are handing over: files the claim with the clinic's reviewing staff so "under review" is actually true.

amount.description: Required for "claim". The exact amount the customer says they transferred, in JOD.

sender_name.description: Required for "claim". The sender name on the transfer, exactly as the customer gives it — Arabic or English. Read it from their screenshot if it is there; otherwise ask them. It may not be the customer's own name, since a relative can pay for them.

sent_at.description: Required for "claim". When the customer says they sent it, as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" or ISO-8601. If they say "at 1:17 today", pass today at 13:17.

approval_code.description: Required for "settle". The code returned by an approved claim, e.g. BT-7F3K92.

clinic_customer_uuid.description: Required for "settle". The customer's clinic UUID (16 uppercase hexadecimal characters) from the customer lookup tool.

user_package_id.description: Required for "settle" when destination is "package". Which package to apply the payment to. Packages only exist AFTER the cart is submitted. Leave out for destination "wallet".

branch_id.description: Required for "settle". The branch the customer is booked at — the same branch_id you used for this booking. Money can never be recorded without a branch.

note.description: Optional for "flag_for_review": one sentence of context for the reviewing staff member (e.g. the correct sender name the customer gave after the claims failed).

allocation_amount.description: Optional for "settle". How much of the approved transfer to record for THIS person. Leave it out to record everything still unallocated. Use it when ONE transfer pays for several people: if she sent 500 and says "200 on my profile, 150 for my sister, 150 for my mother", call settle THREE times with the SAME approval code and allocation_amount 200, then 150, then 150. Never pass the full transfer amount for a single share.

beneficiary_is_claimant.description: Required for "settle". true when the person being credited is the same person who claimed the transfer. false for anyone else — her sister, her mother, a friend.

beneficiary_relationship.description: Required whenever beneficiary_is_claimant is false. Their stated relationship in the customer's own words — sister, mother, wife, friend.

authorization_statement.description: Required with beneficiary_relationship. Quote what the customer actually said, e.g. "200 لي و150 لأختي و150 لأمي".

destination.description: Where the money goes on "settle". "package" (the default) applies it to something she is buying or paying off — including a MEMBERSHIP: memberships have no cart, and their money row is NOT in get_customer_packages "packages"; take the user_package_id from get_customer_packages "payable_memberships" (the membership money rows that still owe money). "wallet" adds it to her stored credit instead — ONLY when she transferred money without anything to pay for, or sent more than the thing costs.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 20, max: 50)

action.description: The extraction mode. Defaults to "extract_from_conversation". Only this value is currently supported.
